description: This PHP class `Returns` is a model component for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically handling reporting functionality related to product returns. It provides methods to retrieve return records with filters and to count total returns, supporting filtering by return status, date range, and groupings such as day, week, month, or year.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Model class responsible for fetching and counting return records for reporting purposes within the OpenCart admin panel, supporting filtering by status, date, and grouping.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Retrieves a list of return records filtered by optional parameters such as return status, date range, and grouping (day, week, month, year). Supports pagination with start and limit.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Calculates the total number of distinct return records based on similar filters, giving an overall count summary.
